items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: studying with a great saxophone player named Gary Campbell who was teaching at the University of Miami when I was there

ctx.x: Yeah I’d like to get to that 365 Days.

So in that book — so we could talk about the structure of the book later but in the beginning of that book I talk about this practice routine that I kind of learned and developed as a result of studying with a great saxophone player named Gary Campbell who was teaching at the University of Miami when I was there some years ago, and who also went to Indiana University when Michael Brecker was there so they used to practice together. And Michael always credits Gary as being a big influence on his practicing. So…
